text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp season arrived 
once again this year. However, unlike last 
year—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, not a cloud in the sky! It truly 
feels like perfect training camp weather~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Or is that not why you're gazing up at 
the sky? What's the matter, Chiyo-chan? 
You've had your head in the clouds ever 
since the bus ride.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-san... Well, no, that's... I just 
couldn't help wondering how Laurel-san is 
doing...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That's right. She went to France, 
didn't she? ...For the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, they said to start early so my body 
can get used to it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Knowing Laurel-san, I'm sure... she's 
working hard on her training right now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's an unfamiliar place, and there are 
plenty of hardships, but... she certainly 
won't break—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wait, no, absolutely not!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"You're right, Laurel-san is definitely 
giving it her all out there too! I don't 
have time to be moping around feeling 
lonely!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm gonna train like crazy this 
summer! Maruzen-san, see you later!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Fufufu, it seems there was no need to 
worry after all?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh! What's with that!? Are you telling 
me Mayano isn't even coming to summer 
camp!?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I-It seems so... Because she's still 
"secluded in the mountains" with 
Brian-san.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Dummy, dummy! Come to the beach, not the 
mountain! Even though we're doing an 
inter-class dodgeball game in our free 
timeâ

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Looks like our class will be a little 
short on people..."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, but Mayano's also been training and 
working super hard the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Then I can't afford to lose while 
they're gone!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Even if the odds are against us, a hero 
never gives up! Let's give hardworking 
Mayano a class victory as a present!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Humph, of course I'll win! If push comes 
to shove, I even have duplication magic.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna show you an amazing victory 
that'll make Mayano totally regret saying 
"I should've entered~!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're right♪ Let's all do our best 
for Mayano-san's sake too!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer, neither Laurel, Mayano, nor 
Brian are here. Even though we were all 
running on this same beach last year!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
All three of you have drifted so far away, 
haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Still— Chiyono O and Biko are the same, 
and so am I!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
From right here☆ From anywhere★ I can feel 
their marvelousness☆★☆
choice_data_list:
That's why it gives us motivation to do 
our best too.

That's why it gives us motivation to do 
our best too.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yes, Marvelouuuuus☆★☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Trainer!! What should we do 
first? Where do we start?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The sun is still glaring down dazzlingly 
right now, but once the breeze turns cool, 
the Tenno Sho (Autumn) will be here in the 
blink of an eye!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the intense summer training camp 
with Marvelous Sunday kicked off!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, on the other hand—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Umm... looks like she's not here?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka, a front-running specialist 
who debuted last year, and Air Groove, the 
formidable powerhouse known as 'The 
Empress,' had come to the beach.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm certain the time and place were 
right. Where on earth did that girl run 
off to——"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey! Sorry about that, you two!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I only intended to do a light 
warm-up, but I got completely carried 
away.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Even though I was the one who asked for a 
tandem run, I'm so sorry for keeping you 
waiting!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...It is fine. I have not been waiting 
long. More importantly, you haven't been 
acting recklessly in your excitement, have 
you?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
You're still not quite in top form yet... 
right?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, if you think it's better not to run 
anymore today—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No, it's fine! Please don't worry. Tachyon 
is helping me out, so we're keeping strict 
control over my meal plans.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I won't do anything reckless. But... I 
will push right up to the very brink.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm counting on you two. By 
running with you active shining stars, I 
need to remind this rusty body what 
competition feels like!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...You say you're being rigorous, but if I 
see anything out of the ordinary, I'm 
putting a stop to it immediately.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, so long as there's no issue, I 
will show no mercy. —Let us begin.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Looking forward to working with you, 
Air Groove, Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oops... Before that, sorry. Do you mind if 
we move somewhere else for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The training location was closer than I 
thought.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...? Well, I don't mind, but—what is it?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haha... Nah, it's nothing, really.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Particulars, pride, stubbornness... Or 
maybe just trying to hide embarrassment.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well, basically— I just really wanted to 
surprise you, since I had the chance!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Phew, phew... Ehehehe☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha☆★☆ MAAARVELOOOOUUUS★☆★

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday sprinting across the 
beach. And Fuji Kiseki quietly slipping 
away from her side.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume's summer grows hotter day by 
day—
